title: Beyond the 956: Paralympic Silver Medalist Lee Fryer Charged With 11 Counts of Rape in the UK
excerpt: British wheelchair basketball player Lee Fryer, 26, a silver medalist at the Paris 2024 Paralympics, has been charged with 11 counts of rape among 17 total charges in the United Kingdom. He has pleaded not guilty, and his trial is set for March 22, 2027.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

British wheelchair basketball player Lee Fryer, 26, a silver medalist at the Paris 2024 Paralympics, has been charged with 11 counts of rape among 17 total charges in the United Kingdom, according to WorldStar and multiple news reports.

Fryer, from Pontefract in West Yorkshire, appeared at Leeds Crown Court on Thursday, November 19, 2026, by video link from custody. He pleaded not guilty to 16 of the charges, and no plea was entered on the voyeurism charge, according to BBC reporting.

Beyond the 11 rape counts, Fryer faces charges including voyeurism, intentional strangulation, assault occasioning actual bodily harm, controlling or coercive behavior in an intimate relationship, possession of cocaine, a Class A drug, and perverting the course of justice.

The allegations concern one woman and relate to alleged incidents in England, Spain, and South Africa between May 2021 and May 2026. The woman has not been named.

Fryer was remanded in custody following the hearing. His trial is scheduled to begin at Leeds Crown Court on March 22, 2027.

Fryer is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: WorldStar (@worldstar) Instagram post, https://www.instagram.com/p/DgGUqUWyFFk/; Baller Alert — “Paralympic Medalist Lee Fryer Suspended From Team Amid 11 Rape Charges”, https://balleralert.com/paralympic-medalist-lee-fryer-suspended-rape-charges/; BBC News reporting via multiple outlets.
